title: Mary R NDE21892 NDE 21892
content: As I was on the floor and the blows just kept coming, I held my breath; thinking that my back would stop going up and down and they would think that I was dead or passed out. Just as my lungs seemed on fire and I needed air, my nine month old daughters face came before me and a calm came over me. Then there was a very small moment of total darkness and then I found myself walking upward through an old stone and earth tunnel that had a bright white light at the end. Before I got to the light, the stones and earth turned into the heavens with all of the stars. I instantly knew all of their names and purpose and they seemed as though they were living beings with a reason for being created. One in particular I was told was my birth star. Everything was within a heartbeat yet seemed as if time had stopped. You knew things all at once yet separate as well. There was an angel walking on my right side with me the entire way and I was told he was my guardian angel. I saw my entire life as though I was watching a movie. There was an invisible border you could not see yet you understood not to cross it or you could not leave. Horses and dogs were playing together and when they stopped, they seemed to stare a hole through me and then went back to playing. I was told they were checking to see if I was the person they were waiting for that they had loved while on earth. Then I saw babies as far as the eye could see and then some. They were ‘our precious abortion babies’ said the angel. But when I told him they were all different ages, he told me you don't stay a baby but will grow to about thirty-four or thirty-six. I was told I needed to get the word in me while on earth because I couldn't approach God in the great Throne Room until a certain level of knowledge was attained. I could learn it there but it would slow down my journey. There were people going up to a group of trees. The leaves looked just like magnolia leaves yet they were about two feet long and more slender. They would grab a branch in their arms and smell with long deep breaths. They were ‘smelling the leaves for the healing of the nations.’ I asked what that meant and the angel then told me to look it up and just smiled when I told him my mom used to tell me that all of the time when I asked how to spell certain words and he said, ‘I know’. Then the angel motioned for me to go in and an intense sadness came over me, which was so different from the total peace that I felt. Feelings were extremely intense and definite. I told him that I couldn't go in. He couldn't understand why I wouldn't go on in since he kept saying but you don't understand you GET to go in. I then told him that if I went in my babies would never know the Lord and then the angel acted as if he was listening to someone else that I could not hear. He smiled at me and told me that I was allowed to return if I wanted to. The next thing I knew was being back on the floor with the pain and blows. There was an angel that was protecting me and was so enormous that I was the size of a two year old compared to a six foot man hovering over me. He told me his name was Cannon and to be still and he began blowing on the back of my neck and I started getting warm. A fear came over one man and Cannon pulled him to the door to get out. After I heard the register ring and the bell on the door ring, I wanted to go to sleep. I had lost a lot of blood and could hear the crunching of bone in my head when I moved. Cannon kept telling me to get up and not to go to sleep and I couldn't get up. I remember him telling me to ‘GET UP’ and I would tell him I couldn't. He then picked me up and I remember his hands being the width of my ribcage as he dragged me to the payphone and my left foot was dragging behind me. As he blew on me one last time, I came to and realized that I had been robbed. I had blood everywhere and as I got the dime that was taped to the bottom of the phone, I called the operator and told him I had been robbed and had blood all over. A patrol car was on the way at that time. Apparently, the officers had a visit from an angel that took up the entire back seat of their car and told them to get to me fast because I was hurt. I still cannot walk on gravel because of the sound that reminds me of crunching bone. I am now seriously attention deficit and on medication and jump when someone comes up behind me. I also am very well known for being able to see angels and demons around a person and can read a person's life as if it was written in a book and all I had to do was read it off. I then give encouragement because of what they are presently going through with the knowledge of what is about to happen to them. It is scary for me because only God knows our future and to be used is a great honor and I take my gifts very seriously. I never did this before my attack. Was I there in heaven? Yes. I wish that I could bottle the fragrance of paradise that permeated the ambulance, my clothes, hair and emergency room for three days. I still stop automatically every time one of the fragrances hits my nose. The other day I got to find out what one of the odors was, it was frankincense.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: walking upward through an old stone and earth tunnel

arrival.other_being_detail: An angel on her right side identified as her guardian angel; later an angel named Cannon protecting her during return.

environment.environment_other_detail: Heavens with stars; an invisible border; horses and dogs playing; babies as far as the eye could see; a group of trees with magnolia-like leaves about two feet long that people smelled for healing.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told she needed to “get the word in me while on earth” because she couldn't approach God in the great Throne Room until a certain level of knowledge was attained.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Beaten during a robbery/attack; significant blood loss and head injury.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Star knowledge (names/purpose; “birth star”); animals (horses/dogs) and “abortion babies”; “Throne Room” requirement; fragrance of paradise/frankincense lingering after return; angel intervention reported by police officers.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Darkness → tunnel with light → heavens/stars → accompanied by guardian angel → life review → boundary/Throne Room approach with sadness → choice to return → abrupt return to body and continued angel protection.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: “Everything was within a heartbeat yet seemed as if time had stopped. You knew things all at once yet separate as well.”

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Instant knowledge of stars’ names/purpose and being told one was her “birth star”; animals “checking” if she was the person they were waiting for; “abortion babies” realm with growth to age ~34–36; smelling magnolia-like leaves “for the healing of the nations”; instruction about needing sufficient knowledge before approaching God in the “great Throne Room”; named angel “Cannon” physically dragging her to a payphone; reported angel appearing in police car; lingering fragrance of paradise/frankincense for three days.
